        return 1000000.0

    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    if pod.current_node == node.id:
        cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated
        mem_after = node.mem_allocated
    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return -1000000000000.0
    if cpu_after > node.cpu_capacity or mem_after > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000000000.0

    incoming_worst = 0.0
    outgoing_worst = 0.0
    latency_total = 0.0
    connected_count = 0
    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        incoming = False
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        elif destination == pod.id:
            other = source
            incoming = True
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:

            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                if incoming:
                    latency = ctx.nodes[neighbor.current_node].latency_to_ms[node.id]
                if neighbor.current_node == node.id:
                    latency = 0.0
                if incoming:
                    incoming_worst = max(incoming_worst, latency)

                connected_count += 1

# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def pressure(requested: int, capacity: int) -> float:
    if capacity <= 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 1000000.0
    utilization = float(max(requested, 0)) / float(capacity)
    return utilization / max(1.0 - utilization, 0.01)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    if pod.current_node == node.id:
        cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated
        mem_after = node.mem_allocated
    if node.cpu_capacity <= 0 or node.mem_capacity <= 0:
        return -1000000000000.0
    if cpu_after > node.cpu_capacity or mem_after > node.mem_capacity:
        return -1000000000000.0

    incoming_worst = 0.0
    outgoing_worst = 0.0
    latency_total = 0.0
    connected_count = 0
    for edge in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[edge]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[edge]
        other = -1
        incoming = False
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        elif destination == pod.id:
            other = source
            incoming = True
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                if incoming:
                    latency = ctx.nodes[neighbor.current_node].latency_to_ms[node.id]
                if neighbor.current_node == node.id:
                    latency = 0.0
                if incoming:
                    incoming_worst = max(incoming_worst, latency)
                else:
                    outgoing_worst = max(outgoing_worst, latency)
                latency_total += latency
                connected_count += 1

    cpu_utilization = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_utilization = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    cpu_pressure = pressure(cpu_after, node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_pressure = pressure(mem_after, node.mem_capacity)
    service_pressure = float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    service_pressure = service_pressure / max(1.0 - cpu_utilization, 0.01)
    cpu_excess = max(cpu_utilization - 0.60, 0.0)
    mem_excess = max(mem_utilization - 0.80, 0.0)

    power_delta = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    incremental_power = power_delta * float(pod.cpu_request) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    activation = node.suspended or (node.suspendable and node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0)
    if activation and pod.current_node != node.id:
        incremental_power += node.power_idle_w
    if pod.current_node == node.id:
        incremental_power = 0.0

    path_latency = incoming_worst + outgoing_worst
    average_latency = latency_total / float(max(connected_count, 1))
    cost = 8.0 * path_latency + average_latency + 0.5 * latency_total
    cost += 18.0 * cpu_pressure + 3.0 * mem_pressure
    cost += 80.0 * service_pressure
    cost += 400.0 * cpu_excess * cpu_excess
    cost += 140.0 * mem_excess * mem_excess
    cost += 0.35 * incremental_power
    return -cost

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:

    return out
